authority_scope: Concrete design and CPU inspection only; no new GPU job or live-job modification

common.inactive_current_loss: NEW_COMMON_CHANGE: include inactive NLL and native KL; R columns stay zero
common.loss_units: target-token mean, six-context mean, current-request SUM; each reference mean multiplied by B
common.burden_M: P_l.T@A_l@P_l; small S-S@S route verified against direct expression
common.burden_s_squared: mean_r norm(h_l,r)^2 at own batch entry
common.burden_ideal_vs_actual: objective uses ideal FP64 RP.T energy; final-only diagnostics separately compute actual FP32 committed-minus-entry energy
common.history: post all-five writes: append each H once using own post keys, all occurrences including zero/duplicates

general_exclusions: canonical prompt overlapping any fixed10k R/P/N prompt
references.general_teacher: pretrained W0 FP32 full-vocabulary log probabilities
references.general_positions: all true-target teacher-forced prediction positions; token mean then prompt mean
references.replay_loss: desired-new full-target NLL; token mean then prompt mean
references.replay_membership: latest committed occurrence per claim, excluding current-batch claims; no score-based filtering
references.replay_strata: sort latest occurrences oldest-to-newest; four contiguous quartiles; up to four per quartile, deterministic fill
references.empty_replay: zero; do not rescale general weight
references.rank_key: SHA256 compact UTF8 JSON [seed,batch_index,group,case_id], then integer case_id

runtime.solver: existing SPG/BB/group-norm prox/line search; same settings across arms
runtime.direct_R_backward: common technical comparison before route freeze; preserve materialized forward and dX
runtime.route_selection: same route/microbatch for both arms, selected on fixed-candidate timing/memory and recorded numerical differences, not scientific arm outcomes

policy.finite_numerical_difference: retain original threshold verdict and observed errors; CONTINUE_WITH_WARNING, no certification claim
policy.commit_weight_identity: bitwise with final original materialized candidate
policy.finite_nonconverged_candidate: fresh-evaluate last accepted or initial point; do not commit rejected trial
policy.trial_nonfinite: OPEN_PROPOSAL: reject non-mutating trial and halve step within cap; initial/final nonfinite remains fatal; current production any-trial fatal rule unchanged

cross_diagnostic.scope: fixed final all-five candidate at the same entry; virtual no-grad interventions, no commit or layer selection
cross_diagnostic.prompt_groups: up to four current, four relation-matched general reference, four past reference; canonical prompt and subject lookup; deterministic ID order
cross_diagnostic.quantity: d_joint - sum_l d_l at same input/subject L8 block output; absolute and relative norm, near-zero denominator marked NA

compare: quality and cost at actual wall time
locality and per-layer burden at comparable edit strength
